title: Refund Policy
intro: At NYX, we accept payments exclusively in cryptocurrency. This policy explains how refunds work for crypto payments made through NOWPayments, and how your privacy is protected throughout the process.
payments_desc: NYX Pro is paid for exclusively with cryptocurrency via NOWPayments — Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and other supported coins. Each checkout generates a secure invoice with a fixed amount and a dedicated receiving address. Blockchain transactions are final and cannot be reversed once confirmed.
refund_desc: If you are not satisfied with your NYX Pro upgrade, you may request a full refund within 7 days of payment. Refunds are issued in the same cryptocurrency, back to the original paying address or wallet. Network transaction fees are borne by the requester, and refunds are subject to prevailing network conditions. Only the original transaction is eligible.
zk_desc: Your privacy remains intact. Claiming a refund requires only your Transaction or Order ID — never access to your device, decryption keys, or any chat content. We verify the transaction on-chain and nothing more.
how_to_claim_desc: To request a refund, send an email to billing@nyx-app.my.id with your NOWPayments Transaction or Order ID. Our team verifies the payment on-chain and processes eligible refunds within 3–5 business days.
